caseNameFull: Charles H. Spear, etc. v. United States

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

This cause is dismissed for lack of jurisdiction in this court under § 238 of the Judicial Code as amended by the Act of February 13, 1925, c. 229, 43 Stat. 936.
